Williams, Jr. for the National Malleable & Steel Castings Co., James C. Davis, John B. Robinson, Jr. and Orrin B. Garner for the American Steel Foundries, Webb I. Vorys for the Buckeye Steel Castings Co., Wilmer Mechlin for the Symington Wayne Corporation, Charles W. Sellers for the McCon-way & Torley Corporation, and Kenneth F. Burgess, D. opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted. Mr. Justice Burton took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
